# Recap of Days 1–4 {background-color="#2C5F77"}

## Highlights

- Day 1: Copernicus and Philippine EO data, AI/ML basics, Python geospatial, Google Earth Engine
- Day 2: Random Forest land cover (Palawan), CNNs, transfer learning
- Day 3: U-Net segmentation, Sentinel-1 flood mapping, object detection
- Day 4: LSTM drought forecasting (Mindanao), foundation models, embeddings, SSL, XAI

---

## Technique Selection Matrix

- Classification (image/patch) → CNN / transfer learning, or a classifier on embeddings
- Segmentation (pixel-wise) → U-Net / GeoFM fine-tuning
- Detection (bounding boxes) → YOLO/SSD/DETR
- Time series → LSTM/Transformers, temporal validation
- Tabular + EO features → Random Forest/XGBoost

---

# Best Practices {background-color="#2C5F77"}

## Data-Centric AI

- Fix labels, balance classes, represent regions/seasons

## Validation

- Temporal splits, spatial CV, stratified sampling

## Monitoring

- Concept/data drift, retraining schedule, dashboards

## Deployment

- APIs, performance budgets, documentation, XAI

---

# Platforms & Continued Learning {background-color="#2C5F77"}

## Philippine EO Platforms

- **CopPhil Infrastructure** (Copernicus mirror site hosted at PhilSA): Sentinel data, JupyterLab, [infra.copphil.philsa.gov.ph](https://infra.copphil.philsa.gov.ph)
- **CopPhil Digital Campus**: self-paced EO courses, [courses.copphil.philsa.gov.ph](https://courses.copphil.philsa.gov.ph)
- **SkAI-Pinas / DOST-ASTI:** DIMER (model repository), AIPI
- PhilSA Space+ Data Dashboard, [NAMRIA Geoportal](https://www.geoportal.gov.ph), [PAGASA climate data](https://www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph/climate/climate-monitoring)

## Keep Learning

- All course materials stay online: [anefelo.github.io/eo-ai-ml-training](https://anefelo.github.io/eo-ai-ml-training/)
- Earth Engine tutorials, [EO College](https://eo-college.org), TorchGeo / TerraTorch docs
- Learn with colleagues: pick a shared project, review each other's notebooks

---

## 3-Month Action Plan

- Week 1: Pick a starter project, run baseline
- Month 1: Proof of concept with validation
- Month 2: Improve data + model, stakeholder review
- Month 3: Pilot deployment + monitoring
